Cheesy Wheels Of Doom (often abbreviated as CWOD) is a studio project from Bonn, Germany, founded in 2007 by J.T.

The project originated from spontaneous jam sessions and recordings with friends, resulting in the first album "Cock Tails" (2007). Originally intended as a one-off release, CWOD returned in 2014 with the second album "iUnderstand".

After a longer hiatus, the third album "Grind Zero" was released in November 2023, with a line-up including J.T., Schiggy, Mike and Master
